details: Bitcoin's price has climbed above $81,000, reaching its highest level in over a week. This rally is largely attributed to a significant short squeeze in the market, resulting in over $200 million in short positions being liquidated across Bitcoin and Ethereum. Renewed spot demand also contributed to the upward momentum, even as the market digested a Federal Reserve rate hike and the failure of the CLARITY Act in the Senate.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $81K Amid Short Squeeze and Renewed Demand

details: The total market capitalization of altcoins (all cryptocurrencies excluding Bitcoin and Ethereum) has surpassed $800 billion, marking its highest level since early 2026. This indicates a notable shift in market structure, with traders rotating capital out of Bitcoin and into smaller tokens. Several altcoins, including Tezos, XRP, and Solana, have experienced significant gains.
title: Altcoin Market Capitalization Tops $800 Billion, Signaling Rotation

details: Ethereum (ETH) has extended its recent rally, reaching its highest price since January. Ether traded above the $2,616 resistance level, a ceiling that had capped previous rally attempts since late August. This surge is supported by renewed inflows into spot Ether ETFs, which recorded $144 million on Friday after several days of outflows, and lower average transaction fees.
title: Ethereum Reaches Highest Price Since January, Driven by ETF Inflows
